mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above its previous value signals robust demand, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth reverses or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 3.4% triggers positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as it signals labor market improvement.
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not cross the threshold or 5-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above historical averages signal robust demand, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 quarterly growth rate > 0% and HOUST monthly growth rate > 0% in past month
failure_condition: If either proxy fails to meet the threshold or 60-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS remains above 1.5% or returns are negative despite the rate decline in this regime.

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) above thresholds signals balanced demand-supply growth, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 19681.682 and INDPRO > 104.3648 in next quarter/month
failure_condition: If either proxy fails to meet the threshold or 60-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment increase exceeding 5% from the prior month triggers positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as it signals labor demand strength.
failure_condition: If payroll growth does not exceed 5% or 5-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 3% per quarter predicts positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as it signals supply-side expansion.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth does not sustain above 3% quarterly or 20-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Convergence of rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) above thresholds indicates labor market strengthening, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 152536.0 and UNRATE < 3.4 in next month
failure_condition: If either metric fails to converge or 60-day returns are not positive.
